event.description:
One of the biggest competitive Grand Archive events in all of Australia, hosted at Good Games Greensborough!
When: Sunday March 3rd
Entry: $50
Doors open: 9:00am
Round 1: 10:00am
Format: Swiss Best of 3
Prizes:
1st place will receive a 1st edition box of ALC
Winner and Top 8 playmats
Nationals invite for top 8 (Top 4 if less than 50 players)
Participation playmat
Booster packs and promos based on standings
Decklists required
event.name: Grand Archive ALC Regionals @GGG
